directive: 通知の発生状況と話者を踏まえ、必要な情報を簡潔に伝える。変数を保つ。

entries.EN: What the f...?!
entries.JA_current: What the f...?!
entries.JA_new: なんだよ、これ……！？

entries.EN: I used to know him personally... Sorry for the lad.
entries.JA_current: I used to know him personally... Sorry for the lad.
entries.JA_new: 昔から知ってる奴だったんだ……気の毒にな。

entries.EN: Saharov, if that's a surge upcoming - drop me a line.
entries.JA_current: Saharov, if that's a surge upcoming - drop me a line.
entries.JA_new: サハロフ、光熱放射が来そうなら知らせてくれ。

entries.EN: The number of blowouts is increasing.
entries.JA_current: The number of blowouts is increasing.
entries.JA_new: 光熱放射が増えてる。

entries.EN: Maybe it was a suicide?
entries.JA_current: Maybe it was a suicide?
entries.JA_new: 自殺だったのか？

entries.EN: Haven't seen that kind'a shit for ages!
entries.JA_current: Haven't seen that kind'a shit for ages!
entries.JA_new: こんなのを見るのは久しぶりだぜ！

entries.EN: Bastards! Wasted such a good man! When I find you, I'll make you long for death!
entries.JA_current: Bastards! Wasted such a good man! When I find you, I'll make you long for death!
entries.JA_new: くそったれ！いい奴を殺しやがって！見つけたら、死んだ方がマシだと思わせてやる！

entries.EN: One more, one less... Who cares!
entries.JA_current: One more, one less... Who cares!
entries.JA_new: 一人減ろうが増えようが、知ったことか！

entries.EN: Wow! Sidorovich, that wasn't me to waste him, but you still owe me!
entries.JA_current: Wow! Sidorovich, that wasn't me to waste him, but you still owe me!
entries.JA_new: うわっ！シドロヴィッチ、そいつを殺したのは俺じゃないが、借りは返してもらうぞ！

entries.EN: Barkeep, so what should I do now? Ok, I'll go check the body, maybe there's some info on a flash drive...
entries.JA_current: Barkeep, so what should I do now? Ok, I'll go check the body, maybe there's some info on a flash drive...
entries.JA_new: バーキープ、これからどうすりゃいい？よし、死体を調べてくる。フラッシュドライブに何か情報が残ってるかもな……

entries.EN: Ouch! He's been rambling around with THAT a gun and didn't manage to defend himself... I'll take a walk for his barrel... Anyway, I'm the first to claim it mine!
entries.JA_current: Ouch! He's been rambling around with THAT a gun and didn't manage to defend himself... I'll take a walk for his barrel... Anyway, I'm the first to claim it mine!
entries.JA_new: 痛っ！あんな銃を持ち歩いてたのに、自分の身も守れなかったのかよ……銃をいただきに行くか。いや、俺が一番乗りだ。あれは俺のもんだ！

entries.EN: A dog's death for a dog, ha-ha!
entries.JA_current: A dog's death for a dog, ha-ha!
entries.JA_new: 犬には犬の死に様ってか。ハハッ！

entries.EN: Those morons have got completely out of hand! High time to waste'em...
entries.JA_current: Those morons have got completely out of hand! High time to waste'em...
entries.JA_new: あの間抜けども、好き勝手しやがって！そろそろ始末してやるか……

entries.EN: Motherfuckers! No fear, no conciousness!..
entries.JA_current: Motherfuckers! No fear, no conciousness!..
entries.JA_new: クソ野郎ども！恐怖も意識もないのか……！

entries.EN: Hey, lads? Who's up with me to waste those assholes?!.
entries.JA_current: Hey, lads? Who's up with me to waste those assholes?!.
entries.JA_new: おい、みんな！俺と一緒にあいつらを始末しに行く奴はいないか！？

entries.EN: When the hell does it end?!..
entries.JA_current: When the hell does it end?!..
entries.JA_new: いつになったら終わるんだよ……？

entries.EN: Damn it! I was sure I had wasted them all...
entries.JA_current: Damn it! I was sure I had wasted them all...
entries.JA_new: くそっ！全員始末したと思ったのに……

entries.EN: Shit! It was just yesterday that we had a drink and a chat together... Sorry for the kid...
entries.JA_current: Shit! It was just yesterday that we had a drink and a chat together... Sorry for the kid...
entries.JA_new: くそっ！昨日まで一緒に飲んで話してたってのに……気の毒にな。

entries.EN: May he rest in peace! A true stalker he was... I'll go check for the PDA - maybe there's a stash remaining...
entries.JA_current: May he rest in peace! A true stalker he was... I'll go check for the PDA - maybe there's a stash remaining...
entries.JA_new: 安らかに眠れ。本物のストーカーだった……PDAを調べてくるか。隠し場所の手掛かりが残ってるかもしれない……

entries.EN: What is going on with the Zone?.. Before one was afraid of mutants and anomalies, now fellow stalkers seem way more dangerous...
entries.JA_current: What is going on with the Zone?.. Before one was afraid of mutants and anomalies, now fellow stalkers seem way more dangerous...
entries.JA_new: ゾーンで何が起きてるんだ……？前はミュータントやアノマリーが怖かったのに、今じゃ仲間のストーカーの方がよっぽど危険だ……

entries.EN: So, one competitor less... Amen!..
entries.JA_current: So, one competitor less... Amen!..
entries.JA_new: これで競争相手が一人減った……アーメン。

entries.EN: He claimed to be immortal!.. Ha-ha!..
entries.JA_current: He claimed to be immortal!.. Ha-ha!..
entries.JA_new: 不死身だって言い張ってたのにな！ハハッ！

entries.EN: Damn it! He owed me a grand...
entries.JA_current: Damn it! He owed me a grand...
entries.JA_new: くそっ、あいつに大金を貸してたんだぞ……

entries.EN: What did he have on him? Did the slayer take everything away?
entries.JA_current: What did he have on him? Did the slayer take everything away?
entries.JA_new: 何を持ってた？殺した奴が全部持っていったのか？

entries.EN: So a good man wasted!!!
entries.JA_current: So a good man wasted!!!
entries.JA_new: いい奴が殺されちまった……！

entries.EN: That's exactly what he deserved!!!
entries.JA_current: That's exactly what he deserved!!!
entries.JA_new: 当然の報いだ！

entries.EN: I'm nearby right away! Need help?
entries.JA_current: I'm nearby right away! Need help?
entries.JA_new: すぐ近くにいる。助けが要るか？

entries.EN: Those bastards've killed my friend! Has anybody seen them? Witnesses, drop me a line in private channel, please.
entries.JA_current: Those bastards've killed my friend! Has anybody seen them? Witnesses, drop me a line in private channel, please.
entries.JA_new: あのクソ野郎どもが仲間を殺した！誰か見かけなかったか？目撃者は個人チャンネルで知らせてくれ。

entries.EN: One 'veteran' less.
entries.JA_current: One 'veteran' less.
entries.JA_new: ベテランがまた一人減った。

entries.EN: Marked One must've wasted the poor guy.
entries.JA_current: Marked One must've wasted the poor guy.
entries.JA_new: あの可哀想な奴を殺したの、マークドワンだろ。

entries.EN: I've got a feeling... Nothing good awaits us...
entries.JA_current: I've got a feeling... Nothing good awaits us...
entries.JA_new: 嫌な予感がする……ろくなことにならないぞ……

entries.EN: Haven't I been telling him those louses were rambling over there! He didn't listen - so there he is! Dead...
entries.JA_current: Haven't I been telling him those louses were rambling over there! He didn't listen - so there he is! Dead...
entries.JA_new: あそこに害虫どもがうろついてるって、ずっと言ってたんだ！聞かなかったから、このザマだ！

entries.EN: Loser...
entries.JA_current: Loser...
entries.JA_new: 負け犬め……

entries.EN: I'm shocked... He said it was safe there... Lucky me to have refused to go with him at the last moment, otherwise I'd be lying dead beside him...
entries.JA_current: I'm shocked... He said it was safe there... Lucky me to have refused to go with him at the last moment, otherwise I'd be lying dead beside him...
entries.JA_new: ショックだ……あそこは安全だって言ってたのに。土壇場で一緒に行くのを断ってよかったよ。そうじゃなきゃ、隣で死んでた……

entries.EN: Yeah... That's it - raiding for artifacts... Bad luck...
entries.JA_current: Yeah... That's it - raiding for artifacts... Bad luck...
entries.JA_new: そうか……アーティファクトを探しに行ったのか。運がなかったな……

entries.EN: What can I say?.. The Zone is no place for a stroll...
entries.JA_current: What can I say?.. The Zone is no place for a stroll...
entries.JA_new: なんて言えばいいか……ゾーンは散歩する場所じゃないな……

entries.EN: A terrible death! I hope it wasn't painful for the poor guy...
entries.JA_current: A terrible death! I hope it wasn't painful for the poor guy...
entries.JA_new: ひどい死に方だ！あの人が苦しんでなかったことを祈るよ……

entries.EN: It was just yesterday that we carried out a clean-up operation there! Fuck!
entries.JA_current: It was just yesterday that we carried out a clean-up operation there! Fuck!
entries.JA_new: 昨日あそこで掃討作戦をやったばかりだぞ！くそっ！

entries.EN: I've kept telling everybody not to go to that place! Plenty of mutants there!.. I wish I had posted it via the info channel...
entries.JA_current: I've kept telling everybody not to go to that place! Plenty of mutants there!.. I wish I had posted it via the info channel...
entries.JA_new: あそこへ行くなって、みんなに言い続けてたのに！ミュータントだらけだ……情報チャンネルで知らせておけばよかった。

entries.EN: A good guy he was - risky and generous! Helped those in need... Rest in peace, brother stalker!
entries.JA_current: A good guy he was - risky and generous! Helped those in need... Rest in peace, brother stalker!
entries.JA_new: いい奴だった。無茶もしたが気前がよくて、困ってる奴を助けてた……安らかに眠れ、同胞よ！

entries.EN: Another one went out all alone! Do they ever get wiser?! The copybook maxims is never to raid alone!
entries.JA_current: Another one went out all alone! Do they ever get wiser?! The copybook maxims is never to raid alone!
entries.JA_new: また一人で出かけたのか！いつになったら学ぶんだ？一人で探索するな、これが鉄則だろ！

entries.EN: The rambler got torn to pieces!.. Damn it, I better put a bullet through my head!
entries.JA_current: The rambler got torn to pieces!.. Damn it, I better put a bullet through my head!
entries.JA_new: あの放浪者、引き裂かれちまった……くそっ、俺も頭を撃ち抜きたくなる！

entries.EN: Yeah... Where exactly did he kick the bucket?.. I should note the coordinates...
entries.JA_current: Yeah... Where exactly did he kick the bucket?.. I should note the coordinates...
entries.JA_new: それで……どこでくたばったんだ？座標を控えておかないとな……

entries.EN: However many of these creatures get killed, still more of them stay alive!..
entries.JA_current: However many of these creatures get killed, still more of them stay alive!..
entries.JA_new: あいつらを何匹倒しても、まだまだ残ってやがる……！

entries.EN: It is getting so many of them! No place for a stalker to make a step safely!
entries.JA_current: It is getting so many of them! No place for a stalker to make a step safely!
entries.JA_new: どんどん増えてる。ストーカーが安全に歩ける場所なんてないぞ！

entries.EN: So, that was some creature that killed him?
entries.JA_current: So, that was some creature that killed him?
entries.JA_new: こいつを殺したのは、あの化け物だったのか？

entries.EN: Damn rookies! Not even capable to kill a mutant...
entries.JA_current: Damn rookies! Not even capable to kill a mutant...
entries.JA_new: クソみたいな新米どもめ！ミュータント一匹倒せないのかよ……

entries.EN: Whoever online! Lets hunt the monster!
entries.JA_current: Whoever online! Lets hunt the monster!
entries.JA_new: 誰かオンラインにいるか？怪物狩りに行こうぜ！

entries.EN: I've come across a dead body... I wouldn't wish a death like that on my worst enemy!
entries.JA_current: I've come across a dead body... I wouldn't wish a death like that on my worst enemy!
entries.JA_new: 死体を見つけた……こんな死に方、敵にだってしてほしくない。

entries.EN: Monster has torn him into pieces!!!
entries.JA_current: Monster has torn him into pieces!!!
entries.JA_new: 怪物にバラバラにされてる……！！！

entries.EN: It serves him right!
entries.JA_current: It serves him right!
entries.JA_new: ざまあみろ！

entries.EN: Eh, the Zone... So many lives you have taken...
entries.JA_current: Eh, the Zone... So many lives you have taken...
entries.JA_new: ああ、ゾーン……お前はどれだけの命を奪うんだ……

entries.EN: That reminded me of some joke...
entries.JA_current: That reminded me of some joke...
entries.JA_new: そういや、こんなジョークを聞いたことがある……
